depth.note: Depth 3+ is only reliable when parent pedigree pages are harvested; this phase uses subject charts (depth ≤ 2) plus entity links.

network.warning: These statistics are static descriptive only. When used for prediction they MUST be recomputed as-of each race date to avoid leaking future offspring results.

definition.HIGH: Source pedigree page + parent source_id + no conflict
definition.MEDIUM: Named parent without stable source_id (or external-only link)

quality.note: DATA QUALITY indicator — NOT a prediction probability.
